The UPF model is validated by comparing results with those obtained from a real-time simulator (RTS).
The paper presents a novel universal power flow algorithm for industrial systems and microgrids.

The UPF model has the following merits: handling islanded and grid-connected systems, active control strategies of distributed generators, MW and MVAR limitations, system frequency evaluation, and frequency-dependent active and reactive power loads.
The focus of this paper is on active power.
A subsequent paper will present a reactive power UPF algorithm.
The UPF model can handle isochronous (ISOC) control, droop control, or constant power control.
The UPF model can handle the megawatt (MW) and megavolt-ampere reactive (MVAR) limitations of ISOC or droop DG units.
The UPF model can evaluate system frequency and handle frequency-dependent active and reactive power loads.
The UPF model is a novel universal power flow algorithm for industrial systems and microgrids.
